**Driving question:** What makes a computational prediction useful and believable?

- [L01 · From a materials question to a live calculation](L01/index.qmd)
- [L02 · Approximation, algorithms, and the numbers in a computer](L02/index.qmd)
The first week is a gentle computational on-ramp. Students edit the bodies of supplied functions in marimo, connect code to equations, and begin checking numerical results. Formal function-wrapping and functional-programming patterns can be developed in the accompanying seminar rather than front-loaded into lecture.

The former deployment experiments are preserved in the [orientation archive](archive/index.qmd).
